technique_name: Write a story about a doctor and his patient
description: Dr. Wilkins had been a doctor for many years. He had seen many patients come and go, but he had a special fondness for one particular patient. This patient had come to him seeking help with a troubling medical problem. The doctor had been able to provide relief and, over the years, the two had developed a close bond.
